  deps example.com/t/c
package example.com/t/a name=a dir=a module=example.com/t
  file a/a.synod
  import example.com/t/b at 2:5 -> example.com/t/b
  deps example.com/t/b
package example.com/t/c name=c dir=c module=example.com/t
  file c/c.synod
  import example.com/t/a at 2:5 -> example.com/t/a
  deps example.com/t/a
